groups.title: Ring rollers, profile benders and tube rollers · value line
groups.lead: Motorized profile benders with Ø13/16 to 2-1/2″ shafts, ring rollers and tube rollers — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line ring rollers, built in China, add motorized RBM and HRBM profile benders with Ø13/16 to 2-1/2″ shafts — the H models with a hydraulic top roll — the ETR-50 electric tube roller and the CRB-76 decorative ring roller.
points_add: NovoTech value line: RBM / HRBM motorized profile benders Ø13/16 – 2-1/2″ shafts, ETR-50 tube roller, CRB-76 decorative roller

faq_add.q: Premium-line angle roll or value-line ring roller?
faq_add.a: The premium-line PK and HPK angle rolls are built in Turkey for daily structural work — heavier frames, larger shafts, NC options and capacities to 6″ angle. The value-line RBM and HRBM ring rollers are lighter and lower in price for the fabrication, railing and ornamental shop: flat bar, angle, channel, tee and tube to 4-3/4 × 1″ flat on the HRBM65, with one combination roll set for every profile.

set.hero_brand_line: Premium-line angle rolls are built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification with European hydraulic and electrical components; the value-line ring rollers and tube rollers are built in China to NovoTech's specification. All sold with a 1-year warranty and supported from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
